impact.heading: Impact, a lower bound: what the scanners found, not everything the change reaches

impact.unreadable.tests: The tests directory could not be read, so tests may be missing: {reason}
impact.unparsedModels: These model files declare no model this scan could read, so reads of their columns are missing: {files}
impact.missingPages: These pages have no component file to scan: {pages}
impact.unreadableFiles: Not scanned, so any reads in them are missing: {files}
impact.testRequests.unresolved: {count} TestApp request(s) could not be matched to a route, so tests reaching this may be missing: {requests}
